package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	httpmw "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	answeruc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
)

func TestPublicContentContextAcceptsOptionalRelationID(t *testing.T) {
	const relationID = "7f8b2498-4666-4ff2-8527-b5991199ca22"
	request := httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/student/tasks/task-id?via_relation_id="+relationID, nil)
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", "student-id")
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "student_pro")

	ctx, err := authenticatedPublicContentContext(request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("public content context: %v", err)
	}
	got, required := answeruc.PublicContentAccessFromContext(ctx)
	if !required || got != relationID {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected public access context: required=%v relation=%q", required, got)
	}
	userID, role, ok := answeruc.PublicContentAudienceFromContext(ctx)
	if !ok || userID != "student-id" || role != "STUDENT_PRO" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected public audience: ok=%v user=%q role=%q", ok, userID, role)
	}
}

func TestPublicContentContextRejectsInvalidRelationID(t *testing.T) {
	request := httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/student/tasks/task-id?via_relation_id=not-a-uuid", nil)
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", "student-id")
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT")

	_, err := authenticatedPublicContentContext(request)
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected validation error, got %v", err)
	}
}

func authenticatedPublicContentContext(request *http.Request) (context.Context, error) {
	var (
		result context.Context
		err    error
	)
	handler := httpmw.AuthMiddleware{}.Middleware(http.HandlerFunc(func(_ http.ResponseWriter, authenticated *http.Request) {
		result, err = publicContentContext(authenticated)
	}))
	handler.ServeHTTP(httptest.NewRecorder(), request)
	return result, err
}
